No. An OOMKilled container is terminated by the kernel, and the kubelet will restart it based solely on the pod’s restartPolicy. The liveness probe is only evaluated while the container is running; its failure is not required for a restart after OOMKill. With restartPolicy=Always (default) or OnFailure (the OOMKill exit code 137 counts as a failure), the container is restarted; with restartPolicy=Never it is not.
